references.text: The Israelites took the Midianite women and children captive, along with their livestock and wealth as plunder, illustrating the practice of taking women, children, and property as spoils in war.
The Lord instructs Joshua to take the spoil and livestock from Ai for himself, as a direct application of the principle of taking war booty from enemy cities.
The Israelites took all the spoil and livestock from these cities for themselves but killed all the people, demonstrating the execution of wartime rules regarding plunder.
From the cities of Sihon, the Israelites took the livestock and plunder for themselves, as an example of taking war booty that the Lord had given them.
They took all the livestock and plunder from the cities for themselves, showing the same practice of seizing spoils from conquered cities.
Rules for taking a woman from captives in war as a wife, elaborating on how female prisoners were to be treated.
David recovered everything that the Amalekites had taken, including women and children, and also took the enemy's livestock as plunder.
